scope: Runtime integration of published male Battle Prelate ram operator animation packs

browserVerification.surface: Codex in-app browser, local Vite preview
observed: Two existing equipped Battle Prelate avatars loaded with published ram
Authority accepted strike, frozen impact inspected at 0.70 seconds
Close, middle and distant exports retained the frozen strike phase
Left dismount restored its hammer and placed the actor on ground while right operator retained its side
Reboarding succeeded and a quarter turn carried both actors with the ram
Live drive reported 2.50 metres per second with both actors aboard
Reset returned the review campaign to a stationary boarded state
limitations: Review uses production presenters and simulation in an isolated in-memory campaign; full networked multiplayer gameplay was not exercised
Fitted animation pack is compatible with civic_battle_prelate_m only; no fit claim for other bodies
Full keep and stair collision verification is a separate task
